Human Resources Manager Job at Brilliant Performance Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        Brilliant Performance Solutions Limited - Our client, an International Brand in the Hospitality Industry is  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resources Manager
Job Location: Mainland and Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Due to increasing activities, our client urgently requires the servicers of experienced HR Managers who has a minimum of 5 years experience in HR activities in the hospitality business preferably a top brand Hotel.
	Possession of a professional certificate will be an advantage.


Key Duties & Responsibilities


	Managing pensions and benefits administration.
	Approving job descriptions and advertisements.
	Looking after the health, safety and welfare of all employees.
	Organising staff training.
	Monitoring staff performance and attendance.
	Advising line managers and other employees on employment law and the employer's own employment policies and procedures.
	Ensuring candidates have the right to work at the organisation.
	Advising on disciplinary and employee performance problems.
	Recruitment and onboarding of new employees.
	Preparation of monthly pay roll.
	Developing programmes that enhance employee relations.
	Ensuring employees have correct pay and benefits.
	Delivering compensation and benefit comparison reports to the executive team.
	Promoting equality, health and safety within the company.
	Ensuring that company employment policies follow national laws and regulations.
	Advising executives on matters of salaries, redundancy and employment law.
	Recording and processing confidential information.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience in HR activities in the hospitality business preferably a top brand Hotel.
	Possession of a professional certificate will be an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] or [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

&nbsp;Job Position: Junior Service Engineer

Job Summary


	We are seeking a technically competent Junior Service Engineer to support HVAC installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities.
	The ideal candidate will assist in resolving technical issues, supervise field technicians, ensure quality service delivery, and maintain compliance with safety standards.

	Support the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC and air-conditioning systems.

	Basic knowledge of HVAC installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
	Ability to identify equipment faults and assist in resolving technical issues.
	Experience or ability to supervise technicians during field service activities.
	Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
	Good communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.


Salary
N300,000 - N450,000 monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;

 Job Position: Junior Service Engineer
Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos

	We are seeking a technically competent Junior Service Engineer to support HVAC installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities.
	The ideal candidate will assist in resolving technical issues, supervise field technicians, ensure quality service delivery, and maintain compliance with safety standards.

	Support the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC and air-conditioning systems.

	Prepare technical reports on service activities, equipment faults, and repairs carried out.
	Coordinate with customers and internal teams to ensure effective service delivery.
	Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities and service requests.


Requirements


	HND or B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
	1–3 years of relevant experience in HVAC, air-conditioning, or related technical services.
	Basic knowledge of HVAC installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
	Ability to identify equipment faults and assist in resolving technical issues.

	Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
	Good communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

Job Location: Mainland, Lagos

	The Head of Marketing will spearhead our corporate marketing, investor relations, and capital mobilization initiatives.
	This strategic leadership role requires a seasoned financial marketer responsible for driving deposit mobilization, building institutional trust, and attracting High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNWIs) to invest in the company&rsquo;s wealth management products
	The successful candidate will own a strict monthly fundraising target of N500,000,000 (Five Hundred Million Naira) and must possess the end-to-end technical capability to design and develop premium investment collateral from scratch.


Key Responsibilities
Capital Raising &amp; HNWI Acquisition:


	Achieve a strict monthly capital mobilization target of N500 million through aggressive direct marketing and relationship management.
	Identify, approach, and cultivate long-term relationships with HNWIs, family offices, corporate treasurers, and affluent professionals across Lagos.
	Pitch and secure high-ticket investments specifically for the company&rsquo;s Private Placement Notes and Bilateral Asset Co-Ownership Scheme.
	Plan and host exclusive, intimate wealth management events and networking roundtables in premium Lagos locations to build trust and close deals.


Collateral &amp; Content Creation:


	Design, write, and produce high-end investment collateral entirely from scratch, including comprehensive pitch decks, product fact sheets, and investor brochures.
	Collaborate with legal and finance teams to draft clear, compelling, and legally sound Term Sheets and investor contracts.
	Develop financial storytelling narratives that simplify complex asset structures into transparent, low-risk, high-return value propositions for investors.


Strategic Marketing &amp; Brand Positioning:


	Develop and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy focused on deposit mobilization and corporate investment product positioning.
	Ensure all investment marketing materials strictly adhere to Lagos State lending regulations and relevant financial compliance guidelines.
	Position the company as a premier, highly secure choice for wealth preservation and growth within the Lagos financial landscape.


Leadership &amp; Portfolio Management:


	Manage the end-to-end investor lifecycle, providing regular performance reporting and ensuring high retention and rollover rates.
	Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of investment marketers and business development officers to scale the fundraising pipeline.
	Implement and manage a robust CRM system to track investor interactions, follow-ups, and capital fulfillment pipelines.


Qualifications &amp; Competencies
Education &amp; Experience:


	Education: Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 7&ndash;10 years of senior marketing or business development experience in the Nigerian financial services sector (e.g., investment banking, Asset Management, Finance Houses, or Tier-1 Microfinance).
	An MBA, CFA, or professional financial marketing certification is an added advantage.
	Track Record: Proven history of consistently meeting or exceeding multi- million Naira monthly fundraising/deposit mobilization targets.


Technical &amp; Soft Skills:


	Network: An active, pre-existing database of HNWIs, corporate executives, and affluent professionals within Lagos.
	Financial Literacy: Deep understanding of structured finance products, asset- backed investments, private placements, and the mechanics of bilateral co- ownership.
	Content Mastery: Proficient in creating executive-ready slide decks (PowerPoint/Canva) and drafting professional term sheets.
	Communication: Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and relationshipmanagement skills with a high level of emotional intelligence.


What We Offer


	Highly competitive base salary.
	Lucrative, performance-based commission and bonus structure on all funds raised above or within the N500 million target.
	Comprehensive health insurance and official tools for market mobility.


Method of Application&nbsp;
